items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Ray Brown was with us. Jake Hanna. I think Jake Hanna played. I played piano

ctx.x: Yeah, that must have been the last time I heard it, at Dante's on Ellington's birthday.
Yeah. There was Bill Berry. Let's see, Ray Brown was with us. Jake Hanna. I think Jake Hanna played. I played piano, and I can't think of who else, but I played it. And it was well received.
Oh, it was beautiful. I was so impressed, that's why I wanted to hear it again, especially on record, so
